 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0045
 Tracy Edwards, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
3-22-25
Counsel for defendant:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition, and demands strict proof thereof
as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure. Pursuant to Rule 92, Defendant generally denies every material
allegation and requests that Plaintiff be required to prove the charges and allegations by a preponderance of the
evidence.
As and for affirmative defenses, Defendant states the following. First, Plaintiff's own negligence proximately caused
or contributed to the occurrence, including following too closely and failing to keep a proper lookout, and any recovery
must be reduced in proportion to Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility under Chapter 33 of the Texas Ciivl Practice
and Remedies Code. Second, the injuries and damages claimed were caused, in whole or in part, by a preexisting or
subsequent condition unrelated to the occurrence, and Defendant is not liable for such conditions. Third, Plaintiff has
failed to mitigate damages by unreasonably delaying or declining recommended medical treatment, and any award
must be reduced accordingly.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
